subject.title: [AI-assisted] fix(cli): surface session lane busy exits

question: Should same-session Gateway-backed CLI dispatches return terminal LANE_WAIT_EXCEEDED after the wait threshold for all source CLI variants, including admin-authority /new, /reset, and --model calls?
rationale: This fixes a real CLI bug but also changes existing delivery semantics from waiting in the lane to returning a terminal busy result, so maintainer intent should confirm the compatibility tradeoff before merge.

options.title: Preserve All Source-CLI Busy Results
options.body: Repair the branch so ordinary CLI and admin-authority CLI calls all opt into LANE_WAIT_EXCEEDED while non-CLI backend or SDK calls remain unopted.

options.title: Accept Default-CLI-Only Coverage
options.body: Maintain the current PR shape and accept that supported admin-authority CLI variants remain outside the busy-result fix.

options.title: Pause The Busy-Result Contract
options.body: Pause or close this PR until maintainers settle whether terminal busy rejection should be the CLI delivery contract at all.

recommendation.title: Preserve All Source-CLI Busy Results
recommendation.body: Repair the branch so ordinary CLI and admin-authority CLI calls all opt into LANE_WAIT_EXCEEDED while non-CLI backend or SDK calls remain unopted.

likelyOwner.reason: The Gateway-backed CLI relay and adjacent queue diagnostics history make this the best available routing owner for the delivery-contract choice.
